name: Tsujimura Gorou
source:
Tsujimura Renji’s editor and uncle. Whenever the deadline for a manuscript draws close he shows up at the Ghost Tower. He acts even more proud and arrogant than Renji, so everyone’s a little scared of him. Since he used to be aiming to become an author himself, he doesn’t hold back with his criticisms.

[Source: [url=https://tarhs.booth.pm/items/1269]preview booklet[/url]]
